0.original: Vrtra is overjoyed to have been reunited with his sister.

24.original: Speak with Livingway near the Drowning Brand.

26.original: Speak with Atheleys at the Rostra.

48.original: That Azdaja lives is a miracle made possible by the unique nature of the void...

49.original: ...Ah, yes. The aether transmitters, I shall leave with Zero. They will be of more use in the Thirteenth than in the Source.

50.original: I've already seen Varshahn safely to Vrtra. Many would be heartbroken if their “little brother” failed to return home.

51.original: It should come as no surprise that Golbez has a means to travel between the moon and the star, of which we may avail ourselves shortly.

52.original: We have awaited your return with bated breath. As should be apparent, naught of note occurred in your absence.

53.original: A pity there was no need to employ our combat supporters... Still, everyone is safe, and that's all that matters.

54.original: Urianger and the Loporrits are to be commended for ensuring that the seal held fast.

55.original: To think this all began with a simple treasure hunt. Gods, I could sleep for a week...

56.original: Oh, welcome back, everyone! While you were away, a rent in the fabric of reality suddenly appeared! Through it, we could observe you locked in furious battle with Zeromus!

57.original: By the time it closed up, we had seen your victory─well done, by the way─but we still couldn't breathe easy until we knew for certain you were safe and sound. And here you are, thank heavens!

58.original: Dare I hope Azdaja is safe too? And Zero?

60.original: Though we could not return Azdaja to her original form, Vrtra granted her a new vessel using one of his eyes. Her circumstances are unique, but it nevertheless gives me hope that there may be a way to save other voidsent.

61.original: As for Zero, she has chosen to remain in her world, and do what she can to restore it.

62.original: Ah, so the light of hope shines again amidst the darkness!

63.original: Hers is an admirable dream, and I pray that she hops and skips her way to making it reality!

64.original: Perhaps our research into environments capable of supporting life would be of use in the Thirteenth.

66.original: A day may come when the people of the Source and the Thirteenth work hand in hand. In anticipation of this, we must accumulate even more useful technology!

67.original: And I must inform Jammingway as well! I spy an opportunity for the Last Dregs to expand into the void!

68.original: Ah, but don't let us detain you with our cavalcade of brilliant ideas. We'll see that the gate is closed and the seal deactivated, so go home and get some rest─that includes <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>, Urianger!

69.original: As thou dost command. Pray convey our gratitude to the watcher for his timely assistance.

70.original: 'Twould seem Vrtra is preparing to depart. Come, let us descend to the Tower of Babil.

71.original: Upon arriving in Garlemald, 'twould be meet to inform Jullus of our mission's outcome. Let us seek him out at Tertium.

72.original: I suppose we'll have to rename our voidsent slaughter-bots now. A shame. The name just rolls off the tongue, doesn't it? Still, it was a joy to be of aid to the people of Etheirys again!

73.original: Wouldn't it be grand if we could make it possible for people to spend time in the void without protective talismans...

74.original: <hex:024804F2022303>To rekindle Light in the Thirteenth and pave the way for its restoration...<hex:0248020103>

75.original: <hex:024804F2022303>Her crystal helped set these events into motion, did it not? Then through you and Zero, She was able to serve a greater purpose one last time.<hex:0248020103>

76.original: Ah, 'tis you. What news of your mission in the void?

77.original: The fact you've come all this way can only mean there've been developments. I'm all ears.

78.original: It cannot be overstated how invaluable Lord Fourchenault's cooperation was. We must thank him profusely.

79.original: I've lost count of how many times I've come here, but it's apparently enough that the immigration officials no longer interrogate me. Small blessings, eh?

80.original: Without further ado, let us tend to business.

81.original: Father has many demands on his time, but I should hope he can spare us a moment...

82.original: Having been away for so long, it might be nice to stay a while. If only to set Father and Mother's minds at ease.

83.original: Wait, aren't you the Scions of the Seventh Dawn? Or were, rather─I understand you've disbanded...?

84.original: An audience with Lord Fourchenault? You are in luck. The Forum has just this moment adjourned, and he is still inside with the scholarch.

85.original: Please wait here while I inform them of your presence.

86.original: Apologies to have kept you. I trust you won't object if Scholarch Montichaigne also attends.

87.original: My incorrigible children... Were you not assisting with Garlemald's reconstruction?

88.original: Our hosts were most insistent that we take a rest, so here we are. But more importantly, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> has news that <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> would share with you.

89.original: So the threat has passed! These are glad tidings indeed.

90.original: Harnessing Light from the First. A technological triumph...that could have ended in catastrophic failure.

91.original: But let us not dwell on hypotheticals.

92.original: Like the aether from the Isle of Haam, you employed the Light for peaceful─albeit unanticipated─purposes.

93.original: “Knowledge exists to serve the greater good,” as my father was fond of saying. I'm inclined to agree─in this instance.

95.original: It has been established that world-ending crises in the reflections are connected to calamities in the Source.

96.original: As such, the strides you made in understanding the nature of and effecting a change in a reflection may one day prove vital for mankind's preservation.

97.original: The Forum will be eager to review your accounts thoroughly, for every drop of water serves to swell the great river of knowledge.

98.original: Might we prevail upon you to prepare a comprehensive report, Y'shtola? On the subjects of the void and cross-rift travel both.

100.original: We will share these tidings with those who aided you─Kokkol Dankkol not least of all. Now, if you'll excuse us, we must be on our way.

101.original: I should be glad to speak with you both later.
